use_cases: Add premium, interactive smoke-like cursor trails to landing pages and portfolios
Create engaging visual feedback on creative tool interfaces and design platforms
Enhance e-commerce product pages with dynamic, fluid cursor effects
Build immersive, interactive experiences on SaaS dashboards and portfolio sites
ai_summary: A WebGL-based fluid simulation component that renders smoke-like cursor trails with real-time fluid dynamics. Uses multiple fragment shaders including advection, vorticity, and pressure solvers with WebGL framebuffers for realistic fluid behavior. Responds to cursor/touch input with color-shifting smoke particles on a dark transparent background.
